sloka: तपस्तेपे स धर्मात्मा स्वाध्यायनियतेन्द्रियः ।गत्वाश्रमपदं तस्य विघ्नं कुर्वन्ति कन्यकाः ।। ७.२.८ ॥
transliteration: tapastepe sa dharmātmā svādhyāyaniyatendriyaḥ ।gatvāśramapadaṁ tasya vighnaṁ kurvanti kanyakāḥ ।। 7.2.8 ॥

translations.english: That righteous-souled sage, with his senses controlled by Vedic study, performed severe penance, but maidens would go to his hermitage and create disturbances.
